text: I like watching anime, I have a few that I absolutely adore and always look forward to. My favorite ones would have to be between "That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Slime", "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation", "Konosuba - God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!" I honestly can't pick a favorite between these. I think they all are great within their own genre of anime as well as decent story once you get into it. Konosuba has a bit of a dark beginning and can scare some people away from it but if you can get past it, the story and visuals get good. Mushoku has a similar thing at the beginning where it can make people shy away from it, but like Konosuba it gets better once you can get past it.
